purpose: Candidate extraction registry; source nodes are never presumed packaged or artist-approved

canonical.existing_project_source: local project .blend or project-specific private repo

privacy_policy: Store only sanitized IDs and method descriptions in this public registry. Do not push full curves, original .blend, proprietary node graph dumps, sound sources, customer geometry, motion capture or hidden paths.

entries.name: LT / r0 lifetime and deletion
entries.use_case: One stable lifetime operator for future stateful simulations
entries.limits: 482 GPU lifetime checks only; must not claim full work parity. Original tick semantics.

entries.name: initial geometry + per-frame birth
entries.use_case: Preserve actual per-frame emission topology
entries.limits: Output geometry and timing equivalence not yet tested.

entries.name: Simulation Zone state feedback
entries.use_case: Carry point state over frames
entries.limits: Simulation Zone is modifier-context only; do not claim Tool asset. Six declared state slots are not six evolving particle fields.

entries.name: field displacement / Curl
entries.use_case: Recover original movement instead of substitute random/noise fields
entries.limits: Domain, spatial scale and noise identity not yet proved GPU-equivalent.

entries.name: Wave, density and life gate
entries.use_case: Recover actual selective visibility/removal behavior
entries.limits: Precise gate and geometry semantics to verify against source.

entries.name: Sampled music control adapter
entries.use_case: Change music without rewriting the simulation
entries.limits: Sampling looks baked-like; no proven original audio bands or real beat detector. Original curves remain private.

entries.name: Overhead square to wide projection
entries.use_case: Reframe authored clock world for horizontal stage screens
entries.limits: Not a simple crop. Actual projection rig not source verified.

entries.name: Timeline + audio-bake control layering
entries.use_case: Separate authored animation from swappable music
entries.limits: Determine which individual tracks were manual vs baked from source.

entries.name: Left-to-right screen-space flow
entries.use_case: Early 2D flow reuse without 3D complexity
entries.limits: Must find correct historical intermediate file.

entries.name: Romantic flow mapping
entries.use_case: Low-fragmentation lyrical flow variant of shared base
entries.limits: Not necessarily a separable standalone node group; needs original A/B comparison.

entries.name: Tight rhythm mapping
entries.use_case: Musically sharply articulated branch
entries.limits: Beat detection not established, and does not imply generic kick detector.

entries.name: Rule-based independent generator
entries.use_case: Simple stable generative grammar
entries.limits: Separate original version and later FINAL_LOOP.

entries.name: Human observation / polygon camera
entries.use_case: Deliberate manual searching for striking overlaps
entries.limits: Not autonomous AI; may depend on mouse-recorded performance.

entries.name: Machine topology wire reveal
entries.use_case: Build-up of coherent mechanical structure
entries.limits: Which delivered version was actually shown needs evidence.

entries.name: Mesh topology to Curves reveal
entries.use_case: Fast structural reveal and author-directed rotation
entries.limits: Actual selected source to recover, not reconstruct from memory.

entries.name: Curves Shader directional highlight
entries.use_case: Add time and hierarchy to geometric reveal
entries.limits: Exact selected node graph and private recipe not yet verified.

entries.name: Wireframe / Wave / ColorRamp material
entries.use_case: Structured scan and moving illumination on very wide canvas
entries.limits: Do not assume four states mean four physical screens.

entries.name: Noise and glow compositor
entries.use_case: Finishing pass for high-quality authored material
entries.limits: No claimed exact anti-banding solution or verified node graph.

entries.name: Metashape color attribute material
entries.use_case: Reusable vertex/attribute colour shading
entries.limits: Check actual source attribute and film/scanning rights.

entries.name: Factory longitudinal camera travel
entries.use_case: Camera travel in point-cloud factory model
entries.limits: Source backups and license status unknown.

entries.name: Time-offset dancer echo
entries.use_case: Potential future body-time spatial work
entries.limits: Not delivered; rights and rig retiming gate.

entries.name: Music/Show Score input adapter
entries.use_case: Expose same authored visual core to different music or live controls
entries.limits: New design contract, not an original historical Blender node or currently tested adapter.
